privacy.title: Privacy
body: Highs & Lows stores as little as possible.

Without signing in you get an anonymous ID (no email, no name). If you sign in – with Google, Discord, GitHub or an email code – we store that account ID and your email address. For email sign-in we send you a one-time 6-digit code via our provider Supabase; we use the address for nothing else (no newsletter, no sharing).
We store your answers with question, date and score (for stats and real answer frequencies), your progress and – if you pick one – player name and avatar. Player names are public.
Answers that are not on our list are checked by an AI (Google Gemini). Only the question and your answer are sent – no ID, no name.
All data is stored with Supabase on servers in Frankfurt (EU). The website is served by GitHub Pages.

Deleting: “Delete account” in your profile permanently removes all your data. Without an account, clearing this site’s data in your browser is enough; questions via the GitHub project playhighsandlows.
